"""Descriptive trace attribution; never selects policies, cases, or efficacy gates."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections,datetime,gzip,hashlib,json,sys

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
mode=sys.argv[1]
assert mode in ['legacy-v10','confirmation-v11']
if mode=='legacy-v10':
 root=p.parent/'barrel-forecast-model-mixture-20261117/v10-functional'
 analysis=json.loads((root/'qualification-analysis.json').read_text())
 assert analysis['complete']and analysis['families']==756 and analysis['fights']==12096
 output=p/'legacy-v10-decision-attribution'
 expected_cases=3024
else:
 root=p
 analysis=json.loads((root/'confirmation-analysis.json').read_text())
 assert analysis['complete']and analysis['families']==1512 and analysis['fights']==18144
 assert json.loads((root/'independent-confirmation-verification.json').read_text())['passed']
 assert json.loads((root/'fresh-cold-parity.json').read_text())['passed']
 # The audit must not run alongside either quiet serial timing study.
 for stem in ['v11-cost','v11-coverage-cost']:
  status=json.loads((root/stem/'status.json').read_text())
  assert not status['liveWorkerPids']and(status['complete']or status['errors'])
 output=p/'confirmation-v11-decision-attribution'
 expected_cases=6048
assert not output.exists();output.mkdir()
pairs={}
for name,digest in analysis['rawSha256'].items():
 f=root/name;raw=f.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==digest,name
 lines=gzip.decompress(raw).splitlines()if f.suffix=='.gz'else raw.splitlines()
 for line in lines:
  r=json.loads(line)
  if r['mode']not in ['stock','mixture']:continue
  assert r['registrationSha256']==analysis['registrationSha256']
  key=(r['board'],r['game']);pair=pairs.setdefault(key,{})
  assert r['mode']not in pair
  pair[r['mode']]={k:r[k]for k in ['inputSha256','traceSha256','score','actualTurns']}
assert len(pairs)==expected_cases and all(set(v)=={'stock','mixture'}for v in pairs.values())
counts=collections.Counter();outcomes=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter);transitions=collections.Counter()
details=[]
def action_types(turn):
 if turn is None:return ['missing-turn']
 return [a['type']for a in turn.get('chosenDecision',[])]
for(board,game),pair in sorted(pairs.items()):
 stock=pair['stock'];mixture=pair['mixture'];assert stock['inputSha256']==mixture['inputSha256']
 delta=mixture['score']-stock['score'];outcome='improved'if delta>0 else'worsened'if delta<0 else'unchanged'
 a=stock['actualTurns'];b=mixture['actualTurns'];changed_trace=stock['traceSha256']!=mixture['traceSha256']
 first=next((i for i in range(min(len(a),len(b)))if a[i]!=b[i]),None)
 if first is None:
  if len(a)!=len(b):first=min(len(a),len(b));category='recorded-length-difference'
  elif changed_trace:category='trace-or-event-difference-with-identical-recorded-decisions'
  else:category='identical-trace-and-recorded-decisions'
 else:
  left=a[first];right=b[first]
  actor_same=left.get('unitId')==right.get('unitId')and left.get('creatureName')==right.get('creatureName')
  raw_same=left.get('rawIncumbent')==right.get('rawIncumbent')
  choice_same=left.get('chosenDecision')==right.get('chosenDecision')
  if actor_same and raw_same and not choice_same:category='recorded-choice-difference-with-same-actor-and-native-proposal'
  elif not actor_same:category='actor-sequence-difference-before-first-recorded-choice-change'
  elif not raw_same:category='native-proposal-difference-at-first-recorded-divergence'
  else:category='other-recorded-metadata-difference'
 counts[category]+=1;outcomes[outcome][category]+=1
 if first is not None:
  left=a[first]if first<len(a)else None;right=b[first]if first<len(b)else None
  transition='+'.join(action_types(left))+' -> '+'+'.join(action_types(right));transitions[transition]+=1
 else:left=right=None;transition=None
 details.append({'board':board,'game':game,'inputSha256':stock['inputSha256'],
  'stockScore':stock['score'],'mixtureScore':mixture['score'],'delta':delta,'outcome':outcome,
  'traceChanged':changed_trace,'recordedTurnsChanged':a!=b,'category':category,
  'firstRecordedDivergenceIndex':first,'stockTurn':left,'mixtureTurn':right,'actionTypeTransition':transition})
assert sum(counts.values())==expected_cases
result={'id':f'{mode}-recorded-decision-attribution-v1','at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'complete':True,'cases':expected_cases,'sourceRegistrationSha256':analysis['registrationSha256'],
 'categories':dict(counts),'categoriesByOutcome':{k:dict(v)for k,v in outcomes.items()},
 'firstRecordedActionTypeTransitions':dict(transitions),'allCasesAndAllWorsenedOutcomesRetained':True,
 'scope':'Descriptive audit of the recorded action skeletons and full trace digests after completed source study. '
 'Same actor/native proposal at first recorded choice difference supports localized selection changes, but doesnot byitself '
 'prove fullstate or RNG-prefix identity. Event-only/proposal/actor divergences require investigation, never exclusion. '
 'No efficacy/cost criterion, candidate, model or source change; no new independent strength claim.'}
with(output/'summary.json').open('x')as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
with(output/'all-case-divergences.json.gz').open('xb')as f:f.write(gzip.compress((json.dumps(details,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode(),compresslevel=1,mtime=0))
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

 'liveRandomDrawCount','liveRandomPrefixSha256','uuidSequence','rawIncumbent','unit','lap','turn']

 values=[c['mean']for c in group['candidates']if c['actions']==actions]
 assert len(values)<=1

 stock=pair['stock']['root'];mixture=pair['mixture']['root'];job=jobs[key]

 differences=[k for k in prefix_fields if stock.get(k)!=mixture.get(k)]
 prefix_differences.update(differences)
 full={m:[g for g in pair[m]['root']['scoreGroups']if g['horizonMode']=='turns']for m in pair}
 comparisons=[]
 if len(full['stock'])==len(full['mixture']):
  for a,b in zip(full['stock'],full['mixture']):
   same_catalog=[c['actions']for c in a['candidates']]==[c['actions']for c in b['candidates']]
   comparisons.append({'sameActionCatalog':same_catalog,
    'stockSelectedNativeValue':selected_value(a,stock_choice),

    'mixtureSelectedMixtureValue':selected_value(b,mixture_choice)})
 forecasts={m:[f for f in pair[m]['root']['forecasts']if f['horizonMode']=='turns']for m in pair}
 counts={m:{'fullSamples':len(rows),'exactTerminalSamples':sum(f['finishedSim']and f['winningTeam']is not None and f['exactTerminalResults']for f in rows),
  'affectedBarrelBoundaries':sum(len(f['barrelBoundaries'])for f in rows),

 group=job['auditGroup'];by_group[group]['cases']+=1
 by_group[group]['exactRegisteredPrefixes']+=not differences

 for c in comparisons:
  values=list(c.values())[1:]

   by_group[group]['bothChoicesScoredInBothModels']+=1

 for m,data in counts.items():

 summary.append({'board':key[0],'game':key[1],'group':group,'outcome':job['auditOutcome'],
  'turn':job['auditTurnIndex'],'actor':stock['unit']['name'],'lap':stock['lap'],
  'capturePoint':stock['capturePoint'],'rootPrefixDifferences':differences,'snapshotSha256':stock['snapshotSha256'],
  'stockScore':pair['stock']['score'],'mixtureScore':pair['mixture']['score'],
  'stockDecision':stock_choice,'mixtureDecision':mixture_choice,
  'stockInnerSearchDecision':stock['chosenDecision'],'mixtureInnerSearchDecision':mixture['chosenDecision'],
  'fullForecastComparison':comparisons,'sampleCounts':counts})
result={'id':'legacy-v10-first-root-descriptive-audit-20261118-v1','at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'complete':True,'cases':24,'executions':48,'allOriginalInputsFullTracesOutcomesActualTurnsAndForecastControlsExact':True,
 'rootPrefixFieldDifferences':dict(prefix_differences),'groups':{k:dict(v)for k,v in by_group.items()},'casesDetail':summary,
 'selection':json.loads(reg)['selection'],
 'interpretation':'Actual recorded committed turns are authoritative; inner SearchDriver returns are separately retained. Stock barrel-boundary counts are not observed by this treatment hook, so their zero counts do not establish no opportunity. Selected old-bank diagnostics only. from pathlib import Path
import concurrent.futures
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import queue
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

p = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
host='puffalo-legacy-descriptive'
raw=(p/'first-root-audit-registration-v4.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(raw);seal=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert hashlib.sha256((p/'strength-registration.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==reg['sourceManifestSha256']
for row in [*json.loads((p/'strength-registration.json').read_text())['files'],*reg['files']]:
 assert hashlib.sha256((p/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],row['path']
assert subprocess.check_output(['bun','--version'],text=True).strip()=='1.4.4'
workers=reg['workers'];deadline=reg['deadlineUnix'];jobs=json.loads((p/'first-root-audit-cases.json').read_text())
assert len(jobs)==24
out = p / 'first-root-audit-results-v4'
out.mkdir()
q = queue.Queue()
for job in jobs: q.put(job)
lock = threading.Lock()
stop = threading.Event()
processes = []
state = {'complete': False, 'host': host, 'expectedCases': len(jobs), 'completedCases': 0, 'fights': 0, 'errors': []}
started = time.monotonic()

def status():
    payload = {**state, 'elapsedSeconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
        'controllerPid': os.getpid(), 'liveWorkerPids': [proc.pid for proc in processes if proc.poll() is None],
        'registrationSha256': seal, 'absoluteDeadlineEpoch': deadline}
    tmp = out / 'status.tmp'
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload) + '\n')
    tmp.replace(out / 'status.json')

def terminate_owned():
    stop.set()
    with lock:
        state['errors'].append('Common fixed execution deadline reached; no extension')
        for proc in processes:
            if proc.poll() is None: proc.terminate()

remaining = deadline - time.time()
assert remaining > 0, 'The registered common deadline is already past'
timer = threading.Timer(remaining, terminate_owned)
timer.daemon = True
timer.start()

def lane(i):
    with (out / f'worker-{i}.log').open('w') as log:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(['nice', '-n', '19', 'bun', '--preload', str(p/'alias.ts'), str(p/'first-root-audit-actor-v4.ts'), str(out/f'worker-{i}.jsonl')],
            cwd=p, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=log, text=True, bufsize=1,
            env={**os.environ, 'HOC_A19_CONTEXT_POLICY': 'on'})
        with lock: processes.append(proc)
        try:
            while not stop.is_set():
                assert time.time() < deadline
                try: job = q.get_nowait()
                except queue.Empty: break
                task = {**job, 'stage': 'qualification', 'assignedHost': host}
                proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({'job': task, 'registrationSha256': seal}) + '\n')
                proc.stdin.flush()
                while True:
                    line = proc.stdout.readline()
                    if not line: raise RuntimeError(f'{host} worker{i} exited at {job["board"]}/{job["game"]}')
                    try: ack = json.loads(line)
                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
                        log.write(line); continue
                    if isinstance(ack, dict) and ack.get('verified'): break
                    log.write(line)
                assert (ack['board'], ack['game'], ack['rows']) == (job['board'], job['game'], 2)
                with lock:
                    state['completedCases'] += 1
                    state['fights'] += 2
            proc.stdin.close()
            assert proc.wait() == 0
        except BaseException as error:
            stop.set()
            with lock: state['errors'].append(str(error))
            raise
        finally:
            if proc.poll() is None: proc.terminate(); proc.wait()

try:

    with lock:

        for proc in processes:
